profile_text.body:
Coursera is an online learning platform founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. The company describes itself as offering online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees designed to teach job-ready skills in collaboration with leading universities and companies including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford.

The platform's AI and technical offerings are central to its catalog. Coursera offers the Machine Learning Specialization, Deep Learning Specialization, AI Essentials Specialization, and AI Engineer Professional Certificate, alongside programs in data science, cybersecurity, software engineering, and business fields. The company also offers Coursera Plus, an annual subscription providing unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. According to its site, learners commonly transition into roles in project management, UX design, and data science through programs such as the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, and the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate.

Coursera is a public company trading under the ticker COUR with CIK 0001651562. The company has significant legal exposure in California, with 220 cases listed in the held facts.
